title: Duel Decks Anthology: Elves vs. Goblins: card flavor text

entities.name: Llanowar
entities.description: An elven forest realm whose elves impose harsh penalties on trespassers.

entities.name: Dawn's Light Palace
entities.description: A palace of the elves of Lys Alana with high tiers.

entities.name: Wren's Run
entities.description: A shaded elven place reached by the Lys Alana huntmaster's horn.

entities.name: Lys Alana
entities.description: An elven home whose huntmasters sound a silver horn.

entities.name: Mirari
entities.description: A powerful artifact whose power pulses in the veins of elves and speaks to them with a voice.

entities.name: Wirewood
entities.description: An elven forest home whose elves clash with goblins.

entities.name: Seton
entities.description: A centaur druid who speaks of life's lessons coming from breathing and noticing.

entities.name: Moonglove
entities.description: A substance that, diluted, can etch living tissue and, concentrated, can kill a giant.

entities.name: Skirk Ridge
entities.description: A ridge from which goblins poured like lava and where shamans gather herbs.

entities.name: Ib Halfheart
entities.description: A goblin tactician who orders everyone but himself to charge.

entities.name: Frogtosser Games
entities.description: A goblin festival including the lighting of the Flaming Boggart.

entities.name: Flaming Boggart
entities.description: A goblin effigy lit at the Frogtosser Games.

entities.name: Braids
entities.description: A dementia summoner who enjoys the sounds goblins make when they die.

entities.name: Auntie Grub
entities.description: A boggart of tales who caught a goat and was greeted by her warren with hot tar.

entities.name: Boggarts
entities.description: Goblins who revel in discovering new sensations and live in warrens.

entities.name: Kumano
entities.description: A teacher who tells his pupils each holds the strength of a landslide.

events.summary: In a tale, Auntie Grub caught a goat and her warren greeted her with hot tar.
events.quote: Auntie Grub had caught a goat, a bleating doe that still squirmed in her arms.

events.summary: In a tale, Auntie Grub discovered the fire had made the goat smell delicious.
events.quote: the fire had turned the goat into something that smelled delicious.

relations.note: both reached by the sound of the Lys Alana huntmaster's horn
relations.quote: From the highest tiers of Dawn's Light Palace to the deepest shade of Wren's Run, the silver notes of the horn shimmer through the air
They make funny little popping sounds when they die.

rejected.summary: The goblins laughed as an elf ran away from them, until more elves came back.
rejected.quote: The goblins laughed as the elf ran away, until more came back.

rejected.summary: Goblins poured from the Skirk Ridge, burning and devouring everything in their path.
rejected.quote: They poured from the Skirk Ridge like lava, burning and devouring everything in their path.
